purpose: A small modal dialog for React apps: a titled panel over a backdrop that closes on Escape or a backdrop click, keeps focus inside, locks the page scroll and gives focus back when it closes.

library.title: Modal sheet (dialog: Escape, backdrop, focus kept, scroll locked)
library.note: One shared dialog: a titled panel, bottom sheet on a phone and a card above 600px, closes on Escape or a backdrop click, traps Tab, returns focus, locks page scroll; imports its own CSS. Draws in place, no portal. For the share dialog take vault-share-sheet. For a full-screen picture take picture-viewer.
